Connect Google Maps

        
Use your own Google Maps Platform key to open a Google basemap inside Goguyy Maps.

        

          
          
          

          
Not connected. Your key is only used by this browser and is not sent to the Goguyy backend.

          Requires Google Maps JavaScript API enabled in Google Cloud. Billing may apply. Create a browser key restricted to your website's HTTP referrers and restrict it to only the APIs you use.
        

        
How to get a key

        
  1. Open Google Maps Platform credentials.
  2. Select or create a Google Cloud project and enable Maps JavaScript API.
  3. Create an API key and configure website (HTTP referrer) restrictions.
  4. Paste the key above and choose Connect.

        
Google Maps is shown as an alternate map view. Switch back to your Goguyy map to use the existing custom editing, route and imported-data tools. Google map labels, imagery and usage are governed by Google's terms.
